## Commercial & Licensing Inquiries

**PCS Developer Runtime** is a public evaluation runtime. Production deployment, commercial use, and enterprise features require separate licensing.

### What We Offer

- Commercial runtime access
- Production deployment rights
- Enterprise support
- Conformance and certification paths
- Strategic partnership structures

### Submit an Inquiry

Use our [commercial inquiry form](https://github.com/persistra-ai/pcs-developer-runtime/issues/new?template=commercial_inquiry.yml) for:
- Production deployment rights
- Commercial runtime access
- Enterprise support
- Internal organizational use
- Conformance/certification
- License structure questions

**Contact:** licensing@persistra.ai  
**Response time:** 3-5 business days

---

## Strategic Partnership Inquiries

We evaluate partnership opportunities on a selective basis, prioritizing:
- Platform integration and co-development
- Standards and conformance participation
- Strategic investment and acquisition discussions
- Hardware acceleration partnerships

### Submit a Partnership Inquiry

Use our [strategic partnership form](https://github.com/persistra-ai/pcs-developer-runtime/issues/new?template=strategic_partnership.yml).

**Response time:** 5-7 business days for qualified inquiries

---

## Response Policy

Due to the volume and technical depth of inquiries, we review requests in batches and prioritize strategic, commercial, and deployment-related conversations.

**Technical/evaluation questions:** Use GitHub Discussions for fastest response  
**Commercial inquiries:** 3-5 business day review cycle  
**Strategic partnerships:** 5-7 business day review cycle for qualified inquiries

---

## No SLA or High-Touch Support

This is an evaluation runtime with best-effort community support. For enterprise SLA and dedicated support, inquire about **PCS Commercial Runtime**.
